description: This file defines the public interface and classes for a disk cache system used in network operations, including backend creation, cache entries, and file operations.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Interface for disk cache backend handling cache entries, statistics, and cache management.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with methods for reading, writing, and managing cache data.

classes.name: EntryResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an open or create cache entry operation, owning the entry.

classes.name: RangeResult
classes.description: Holds the result of a range query on cache data, including error status and data range info.

classes.name: BackendFileOperations
classes.description: Interface for file system operations needed by the cache backend, supporting sandboxed environments.

classes.name: UnboundBackendFileOperations
classes.description: File operations that are not yet bound to a specific sequence, can be bound later.

classes.name: BackendFileOperationsFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating file operations objects.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: A simple implementation of file operations using base functions.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Creates a cache backend instance with specified parameters, handling cache type, size, and reset policy.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes internal cache threads to ensure all I/O is complete.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadAsynchronouslyForTesting
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes cache threads, invoking callback when done.
